product_overview: NagarDrishti is a mobile-first civic issue platform that lets residents report neighbourhood problems, discover and support nearby existing reports, and follow a privacy-preserving public status trail. It also provides officers with a controlled triage workflow and gives the public aggregated transparency into municipal service performance.
core_goals: Let citizens file civic issue reports quickly with photo, location, and category details
Help citizens find and support nearby duplicate issues instead of creating redundant reports
Make issue progress visible through public timelines, status updates, and redacted media
Allow officers to triage, assign, update, and document resolution work
Enable citizens to verify claimed fixes and reopen issues that are still unresolved
Expose ward and department accountability signals through public scorecards and breach views

features.name: Citizen Issue Reporting
features.description: Citizens can submit a new civic issue report with category, description, media, and approximate location, and the system preserves the report as a trackable issue.
user_flows: Navigate to /citizen/report -> Select an issue category -> Add a description -> Attach photographic evidence -> Provide approximate location details -> Submit the report -> See the issue appear as an open complaint with a public reference

Navigate to /citizen/report -> Start a new report -> Review duplicate suggestions -> Choose to continue with a new complaint -> Submit the report -> See nearby matching suggestions and the created issue

Navigate to /citizen/report -> Start a new report -> Go offline during the flow -> Save the report draft locally -> Return online -> Resume the draft -> Submit the report -> See the complaint acknowledged after sync

features.name: Citizen Home and My Reports
features.description: Citizens can view their personal dashboard and track the complaints they have filed or supported.
user_flows: Navigate to /citizen -> Review active reports summary -> Open the personal reports list -> Inspect one submitted issue -> See its current status and timeline
Navigate to /citizen/my-reports -> Review reports you submitted -> Filter by status -> Open a report detail -> See its progress history and current stage

features.name: Map Exploration and Nearby Issues
features.description: Citizens and public visitors can explore civic issues on an interactive map, filter by issue type or status, and inspect nearby reports.
user_flows: Navigate to /citizen/explore -> Pan and zoom the map -> Filter issues by category and status -> Select a nearby marker -> See the issue summary and history
Navigate to /transparency -> Explore the public map -> Adjust filters for ward, category, or status -> Open a visible issue -> Review the redacted public details

features.name: Public Transparency Dashboard
features.description: Public visitors can inspect privacy-coarsened issue details, SLA breaches, forgotten issues, and accountability scorecards without seeing private identities or exact addresses.
user_flows: Navigate to /transparency -> Browse the public issue map -> Open a public issue detail -> Review the redacted timeline and proof summary
Navigate to /transparency/scorecards -> View ward and department scorecards -> Compare response and resolution patterns -> Inspect performance flags
Navigate to /transparency/sla-breaches -> Review overdue complaints -> Open a breach entry -> See how long it has exceeded its SLA
Navigate to /transparency/forgotten -> Review long-pending issues -> Open a ranked complaint -> See why it is being amplified publicly

features.name: Citizen Verification Voting
features.description: Citizens can review claimed fixes and vote whether the issue is actually fixed, not fixed, or unsure.
user_flows: Navigate to /citizen/issue/:id/verify -> Inspect the claimed resolution evidence -> Choose Fixed -> Submit the vote -> See the community tally update
Navigate to /citizen/issue/:id/verify -> Inspect the claimed resolution evidence -> Choose Not Fixed -> Submit the vote -> See the issue reopen when the threshold is reached
Navigate to /citizen/issue/:id/verify -> Inspect the claimed resolution evidence -> Choose Unsure -> Submit the vote -> See your vote recorded in the tally

features.name: Citizen Notifications and Settings
features.description: Citizens can review issue updates, manage notification preferences, and inspect app settings including language and offline queue status.
user_flows: Navigate to /citizen/notifications -> Review recent issue updates -> Open a notification -> Jump to the related complaint detail
Navigate to /citizen/settings -> Change the preferred language -> Review offline queue status -> Confirm the updated preferences

features.name: Officer Triage and Resolution Workflow
features.description: Authorized officers can review the queue, prioritize issues, update status, assign work, and add proof of resolution.
user_flows: Navigate to /officer/queue -> Filter the queue by ward, category, or urgency -> Open an issue -> Assign it to a department or handler -> See the issue status move to assigned
Navigate to /officer/issue/:id -> Review the issue details and timeline -> Move the issue to in progress -> Add a status reason -> See the updated status recorded in the timeline
Navigate to /officer/issue/:id -> Review the issue details -> Upload after-repair evidence -> Mark the issue claimed resolved -> See the proof attached and the claimed resolution state appear
Navigate to /officer/issue/:id/proof -> Inspect the submitted proof evidence -> Review suspicious or weak signals -> Decide whether the proof warrants further review

features.name: Research Benchmark and Annotation Workspace
features.description: Researchers can inspect evaluation metrics, review model outputs, and perform blind annotation tasks for the civic issue dataset.
user_flows: Navigate to /research/metrics -> Review live benchmark metrics -> Inspect calibration and performance charts -> Compare results across model versions
Navigate to /research/annotation -> Switch annotator identity -> Label issue category and priority -> Submit the annotation -> See the task recorded for evaluation
Navigate to /research/models -> Review model telemetry -> Inspect confidence and calibration trends -> Compare prediction behavior across runs
Navigate to /research/duplicates -> Review duplicate pair analysis -> Inspect clustered issue relationships -> Examine why pairs were grouped together
Navigate to /research/proof-audit -> Review proof-of-fix audit flags -> Inspect suspicious evidence patterns -> Examine the heuristic reasons for review
Navigate to /research/audit-ledger -> Review the immutable status ledger -> Inspect event history -> Trace complaint transitions over time

routes.description: Landing hero page directing citizens and officials to dedicated portals
Citizen home dashboard with active reports summary and quick actions
Citizen map exploration view showing nearby issues and reports
Multi-step citizen issue reporting flow with camera upload and GPS tagging
List of complaints and reports submitted by the citizen
Citizen issue detail view with status timeline and support vote
Citizen resolution verification voting page to confirm or dispute fixes
Notification center for issue updates and push settings
User preferences, language selection, and offline queue status
Municipal officer overview dashboard with triage metrics
Officer triage queue to review, categorize, and assign open complaints
Officer issue inspection, status updates, and proof submission
Resolution proof review and adversarial fraud inspection
Public transparency geographic map displaying active and resolved municipal issues
Department performance and Transparency Accountability Score (TAS) cards
Public escalation wall listing unresolved complaints past their SLA deadlines
Long-pending neglected complaints receiving automated amplification
Public read-only issue details with cryptographic hash audit trail
Research overview and ML pipeline evaluation dashboard
Multi-annotator blind labeling interface for CivicTrust datasets
Model prediction telemetry and calibration analysis
Semantic and spatial duplicate pair analysis and graph clusters
Adversarial proof heuristic audit ledger
Live reproducible benchmark metrics including Macro-F1 and ECE
Immutable cryptographic audit ledger of all status transitions

features.name: Citizen Issue Reporting
features.description: Step-by-step reporting with media upload, GPS coordinates, category selection, and offline queueing
user_interactions: Provide issue description and location coordinates
Submit issue or save draft in offline IndexedDB

features.name: Public Map and Transparency Explorer
features.description: Interactive Leaflet map displaying categorized civic issues, SLA breaches, and ward clusters
user_interactions: Filter issues by category and status
Click issue markers to inspect details and history

features.name: Officer Triage and Resolution Workflow
features.description: Officer console for ticket prioritization, department assignment, and proof-of-fix submission
user_interactions: Filter queue by ward, category, and urgency
Update issue status to Assigned or In Progress
Upload resolution photo evidence and mark Claimed Resolved

features.name: Citizen Verification Voting
features.description: Community verification mechanism where citizens confirm or dispute claimed resolutions
user_interactions: Inspect claimed resolution photo and timestamp
Vote Fixed, Not Fixed, or Unsure

features.name: Research Benchmark and Annotation Workspace
features.description: Evaluation workspace running deterministic benchmark calculations and multi-annotator blind labeling
user_interactions: Switch annotator identity (Annotator A, B, C)
Provide ground-truth category and priority labels
View live Macro-F1, ECE calibration charts, and selective risk curves
